title: recover-sell-ladys.ts sells the whole LADYS balance on the public mempool with a minimum of 90% of a spot quote that ignores the token transfer tax, a 10-minute deadline and no fee ceiling, so a sandwich bot can take up to about 10% and a tax above 10% makes the sell revert after paying gas

evidence.note: minOut = getAmountsOut(full balance) x 90 / 100: the floor is relative to the spot quote at that moment
deadline now + 600 s; swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens sent to the public mempool (header :6-7 says so on purpose)
getAmountsOut is the router pure-reserve quote: it does not deduct a fee-on-transfer token tax, while the swap itself pays it
plain ethers Wallet; no maxFeePerGas or maxPriorityFeePerGas is set anywhere, so the fee is whatever ethers derives from getFeeData at send time
router, WETH and LADYS addresses hard-coded: a one-off for one token

sibling_sites_checked: The other script sell path is the bot exit engine (EXIT slice; private sells accept any output, AUD-EXIT-001). The deliberate buy public leg computes its own minOut in src/bot.ts (TH-BUY-03) and is the BUY slice. addLiquidity.ts uses zero minimums but cannot load (AUD-SCRIPTS-001). No other script swaps.
severity_rationale: S2: a bounded capital effect (at most the 10% band, plus gas on a revert) under a common condition (public-mempool swaps of a sizeable position are routinely sandwiched). Not S1 because the loss is capped by the floor and the script is a one-off the operator runs by hand while watching it.
recommendation: Decide on card SCRIPTS-03 whether this one-off script is deleted or kept as a general recovery tool. If kept (Phase 29, HYG-03): hold the process lock (card SCRIPTS-01), send through the private route the bot uses for sells, quote with a tax-aware amount (simulate the sell or read the measured sell tax) and set minOut from that, shorten the deadline, and cap the fee.
